text: Clean minimal (Linear / Stripe style). Lots of white space, thin lines, one accent color. Best for a trusted, pro feel.
Bento grid. Dashboard cards of different sizes, like a lunchbox. Very popular now.
Glassmorphism, used lightly. Soft blurred panels over a map. Do not overuse it.
Dark-first "command center" look. Dark map, glowing routes. Feels like mission control.
Soft neumorphic cards. Gentle shadows. Only for small widgets, since it can hurt
Map-first layout. The map fills the screen, and panels float on top.
